title: REVIEW_STATE.json - review loop round state + response_class
description: Produced by /auto-review-loop (State Persistence section: written at the end of every Phase E, overwritten each time). State fields per its SKILL.md plus the v5.1 anti-shrinkage response_class audit hook (artifact-registry.md: 'Round state + response_class'; auto-pipeline drift detection treats a missing response_class as constraint_field_missing).

threadId.description: Reviewer thread ID for round continuity.

status.description: completed is set at loop termination so future invocations do not resume a finished loop.

last_verdict.description: Most recent round verdict. Both 'not_ready' and 'not ready' spellings are accepted: the Phase A output format uses 'not ready' while the ledger field spec uses 'not_ready' (known gap, see schemas/README.md).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601; state older than 24h with status in_progress is treated as stale (fresh start).

response_class.description: Per-concern substantive-response classification (anti-shrinkage protocol). May be an empty array when the round has no reviewer concerns yet, but the field itself must exist. wording-only rounds are invalid (round_invalid: true).

concern.description: The reviewer concern this response addresses.

round_invalid.description: True when the round's fix list was wording-only (round does not consume MAX_ROUNDS budget and must be redone).
